knowledge.overview: Swiss chard provides vitamins K, A and C together with magnesium and colourful betalain pigments that contribute antioxidant activity.
knowledge.whyItMatters: Swiss Chard provides an exceptional concentration of micronutrients and protective plant compounds that support cardiovascular, metabolic and long-term health.

activeCompounds.name: Protective Phytochemicals
activeCompounds.description: Research suggests these compounds may support antioxidant defences, support healthy inflammatory balance and promote vascular health.

healthBenefits.cardiovascularHealth: Supports healthy blood vessels and circulation.
healthBenefits.brainNervousSystem: Provides nutrients important for normal nervous system function.
healthBenefits.eyeHealth: Contains carotenoids associated with healthy vision.
healthBenefits.metabolicHealth: Supports overall nutritional adequacy within a balanced diet.

useWithCaution: People taking warfarin should maintain a consistent vitamin K intake.

practical.storage: Refrigerate and use within a few days.
practical.preparation: Wash thoroughly before eating or cooking.

commonMyth.fact: Cooking reduces some nutrients while increasing the availability of others.

editorial.keyTakeaway: Swiss Chard is an excellent everyday vegetable that delivers a high nutrient density with minimal calories.
